messageGroup.description: The messageGroup must be a valid numerical identifier for the message type.
The messageGroup must be a positive integer.

messageId.description: The messageId must be a valid integer representing the unique identifier for the message.
The messageId must correspond to a valid message group.

timestamp.description: The timestamp must be a valid Unix timestamp representing the time the message was sent.
The timestamp must be in UTC time.
The timestamp must be in nanoseconds since epoch.

id.description: The orderBookId must be a valid integer representing the order book the index price is for.
The price must be a valid long integer representing the index price.
The changePrevious must be a valid integer representing the percentage change since previous corresponding information dissemination.
The changeYesterday must be a valid integer representing the percentage change compared to the previous day's value.
The pointsOfMovement must be a valid integer representing the change between two index values expressed as number of points.
The calculationTime must be a valid string representing the date and time of the Index Price calculation in UTC.
The distributionTime must be a valid string representing the date and time of the Index Price distribution in UTC.

name.description: The participantLongName must be a string representing the full name of the participant.
The participantType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The action must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The side must be either 1 (Buyer) or 2 (Seller).
The quantity must be a long integer representing the quantity of the order.
The onBehalfOfSubmitterId must be an integer representing the user who entered the request.
The sessionSequenceName must be a string representing the session sequence name of the triggered circuit breaker.
The trendIndicator must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The reason must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The timestamp must be a long integer representing the time of the event.
The orderBookId must be an integer representing the order book ID.
The equilibriumPrice must be a long integer representing the equilibrium price.
The bidQuantity must be a long integer representing the bid quantity.
The offerQuantity must be a long integer representing the offer quantity.
The bidImbalanceQuantity must be a long integer representing the bid imbalance quantity.
The offerImbalanceQuantity must be a long integer representing the offer imbalance quantity.
The bestBidPrice must be a long integer representing the best bid price.
The bestBidQuantity must be a long integer representing the best bid quantity.
The bestOfferPrice must be a long integer representing the best offer price.
The bestOfferQuantity must be a long integer representing the best offer quantity.

exchangeId.description: The exchangeId must be a numeric value.
The exchangeId must be unique for each exchange.

marketId.description: The marketId must be a valid integer representing the numeric identification of the market making participant.
The marketId must exist and be associated with a valid participantId.

instrumentGroupId.description: The instrumentGroupId must be a valid numeric identification of the instrument group.
The instrumentGroupId field is only populated if the destinationLevel is Instrument.

modifier.description: The orderBookId must be a valid integer identifier for the order book.
The businessDate must be a valid long integer representing the current business date at the time of the event in UTC time.
The clearingDate must be a valid short integer representing the current clearing date at the time of the event in UTC time.
The participantId must be a valid integer identifier for the market making participant to which the protection quantities apply.
The underlyingId must be a valid integer identifier for the underlying instrument to which the protection quantities apply.
The calculatedQuantityProtection must be a valid long integer representing the calculated quantity value for market maker protection.
The calculatedDeltaQuantityProtection must be a valid long integer representing the calculated delta quantity value for market maker protection.
The timestamp must be a valid long integer representing the time of issue of the new calculated quantity protection values in UTC time.
The openBalance must be a valid long integer representing the open balance from yesterday.

underlyingId.description: The underlyingId must be an integer value.
exclusions: If the instrument does not have an underlying instrument.

underlyingId.description: The underlyingId must always be set, even for cash instruments that do not have an underlying instrument.

strikePrice.description: The strike price must be a positive value.
The strike price must not exceed the upper limit defined for the order book.
The strike price must not be below the lower limit defined for the order book.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date for this order book must be a valid date.
expirationDate.format: Bit pattern with seven most significant bits for year, next four for month, and five least significant bits for day. The year-field starts counting from 1990.

expirationDate.description: The expiration date must be a non-negative integer.
The expiration date should be set to 0 if the order book is not a derivative.
exclusions: If the order book is a derivative

firstTradingDate.description: The firstTradingDate must be a valid date in UTC time.
The firstTradingDate must be in the past or present, not a future date.

lastTradingDate.description: The last trading date must be a valid date in UTC format.
The last trading date must be a valid business date.

groupType.description: groupType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
Default value for groupType is 0 when it is undefined or not applicable.

optionType.description: The optionType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
If optionType is not provided, it defaults to '0' (Undefined).

optionStyle.description: The optionStyle parameter must have a valid value as defined in the specification.
The optionStyle parameter is valid only when updating an order.

sector.description: The fixedIncomeType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The dayCountConvention must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The action must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The OrderTypeAttributes must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The OrderValidityAttributes must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The sector must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The optionType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The optionStyle must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The currencyUnit must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The priceUnit must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The exchangeOrderType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The orderCategory must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The changeReason must be one of the predefined acceptable values.

currency.description: The currency must be a valid ISO currency code.
The currency field should not be empty and must be a string.

currencyUnit.description: The currencyUnit must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
If the currencyUnit is not specified, it should default to '0' (Undefined).

currencyRelation.description: The currencyRelation field specifies the relation between the second and the first unit. For instance, if the currency is USD and the currencyUnit is second, this field will be set to 100, indicating that there are 100 cents in a US dollar.
The currencyRelation field must be set if the currencyUnit is specified as the second unit.

contractSize.description: Ensure that the contractSize is one of the predefined acceptable values.
Set a default value for contractSize if not provided.

priceQuotationFactor.description: The priceQuotationFactor must be a positive integer.
The priceQuotationFactor should not exceed the maximum allowable value for price-related fields.

priceUnit.description: The price unit must be a valid string representation of a price unit.
The price unit must be a numerical value between 0 and 8.

tickSizes.description: Tick sizes must be a positive integer value.
Tick sizes must be one of the predefined values.

decimalsInPrice.description: Ensure that the decimalsInPrice is a valid integer.
Ensure that the decimalsInPrice falls within a reasonable range for decimal places.

decimalsInStrikePrice.description: Ensure that the decimalsInPrice is an integer value.
The decimalsInPrice should be within a reasonable range to ensure valid price formatting.

decimalsInQuantity.description: The decimalsInPrice parameter must be an integer value.
The decimalsInPrice parameter must be a valid integer.

underlyingName.description: The underlyingName must be a string.
The underlyingName must not exceed 80 characters.

issuerId.description: The issuerId must be an integer value.
The issuerId must be present and not null.

settlementDate.description: The settlement date must be a valid date and time in UTC format.
The settlement date must be a positive integer representing the date and time in Unix timestamp format.

active.description: The order status must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The order status 'Active' indicates that the order is currently active in the order book.

indexMarket.description: The date and time of the Index Price calculation must be in UTC.
The date and time of the Index Price distribution must be in UTC.
The timestamp must be a valid Unix timestamp representing the time at which the message was sent in UTC.
The orderBookId must be a positive integer representing the order book the index price is for.
The price must be a valid long integer representing the index price.
The changePrevious must be an integer representing the percentage change since the previous corresponding information dissemination.
The changeYesterday must be an integer representing the percentage change compared to the previous day's value.
The pointsOfMovement must be an integer representing the change between two index values expressed as number of points.

nominalValue.description: The nominal value must be a positive long integer representing the face value or amount that will be repaid when the bond matures.
The number of implicit decimals in the nominal value must be a non-negative integer.

decimalsInNominalValue.description: The number of decimal places in the price must be an integer.
The number of decimal places in the price must be within a reasonable range.

fixedIncomeType.description: The fixedIncomeType must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The fixedIncomeType must be a non-empty string.

couponInterest.description: The interest rate of the bond must be a long integer with 6 implicit decimals.
The interest rate of the bond must be represented as a long integer with 6 implicit decimals.

couponFrequency.description: The couponFrequency must be a positive integer representing the number of coupons per year.
The couponFrequency should not exceed a reasonable upper limit for the number of coupons per year.

nextCouponDate.description: The nextCouponDate must be a valid date.
The nextCouponDate must be in the future relative to the current date.

dayCountConvention.description: The day count convention must be a valid predefined value as per the protocol specification.
The day count convention must be a numeric string.

datedDate.description: The datedDate field must be a valid date in UTC time.
The datedDate field should be set to zero if not specified.

combinationLegs.description: Ensure that the combinationLegs parameter has a valid groupType.
Ensure that the combinationLegs parameter has a valid optionType.
Ensure that the combinationLegs parameter has a valid optionStyle.
Ensure that the combinationLegs parameter has a valid currencyUnit.
Ensure that the combinationLegs parameter has a valid priceUnit.

tradingAtSettlement.description: The settlement date must be a valid date in UTC time.
The giveUpParticipant field should be a char array of length 7, optionally prefixed with a 2 character country code.
The trade slip number must start with '1', followed by a day count, instance identifier, and a sequential number.
The trade number must be an increasing sequence number unique within Instance and Instrument type.
The accountId field should be a char array containing the account used for the deal.
The customerInfo field should be a free text field filled in by the client entering the transaction.
The traded quantity must be a valid numerical value.
The trade price must be a valid numerical value.
The side field must indicate whether the trader is a buyer or seller.
The dealSource field specifies the circumstances under which the deal was made, such as in continuous matching or in the opening auction.

action.description: The order status must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The quantities must be non-negative integers.
The change reason must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The deal source must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
The price must be a positive integer.

participantDefined.description: The participantName must be a unique string and unchanged as long as the participant exists in the reference data.
The id must be a unique integer...
The active field specifies if the participant is active or suspended.
The exchangeId must be a numeric identification of the exchange the participant is connected to.
The exchangeName must be a string representing the name of the exchange.
The participantType must be a byte representing the type of participant, such as General Clearing Member or Non Clearing Member.
The action field must be a byte representing the action type: New, Update, or Delete.
The clearingHouseId must be a string representing the Clearing House ID for the participant.
The organisationNumber must be a string representing the participant’s organization number.

contractName.description: The contract name must be a valid string.
The contract name should not be empty and must have a reasonable length.

tradedInGenium.description: The tradedInGenium field must be a valid string.
The tradedInGenium field must contain one of the predefined acceptable values.
If the tradedInGenium field is not provided, it should default to '0'.

businessDate.description: The businessDate must be a valid UTC timestamp.
The businessDate should represent the current business date at the time of the event.

isinCode.description: ISIN code must be a 12-character alphanumeric string.
ISIN code must start with a two-letter country code.
ISIN code must not contain any special characters.

upperLevelOrderBookId.description: The upperLevelOrderBookId must be a valid integer representing the numeric identification of the upper level OrderBook.
The upperLevelOrderBookId must be present and not null to ensure the identification of the upper level OrderBook.

instrumentClassId.description: The instrumentClassId must be a string.
The instrumentClassId should not be empty and must have a length greater than 0.

derivativeLevel.description: The level parameter must be one of the predefined acceptable values.
Certain levels require additional parameters to be present. For example, level 2 requires exchangeId, marketId, and instrumentGroupId.

decimalsInContractSize.description: The number of decimal places in the price must be an integer.
The number of decimal places in the price must be within a valid range.

decimalsInTermCurrencyQuantity.description: The decimalsInPrice field must be an integer value.
The decimalsInPrice field must be within a valid range.
